changelog: Turn a written elder-checkup schedule into one elder checkup voice clip per labeled cue.

en.description: Turn a written elder-checkup schedule into one elder checkup voice clip per labeled cue. This checkup schedule voice studio records each elder checkup notice audio and community checkup read from the schedule the office already wrote, then delivers 8 to 20 elder checkup voice pack files. Use it for elder checkup clip packs that keep one schedule item on each clip.
en.summary: Turn a written elder-checkup schedule into one elder checkup voice clip per labeled cue.
en.title: Elder Checkup Voice: Schedule Notice Clips
